mapper.select: select nb.id as 'id', nb.title as 'title', pf.nickname as 'authorName', nb.view_cnt as 'viewCnt', nb.created_at as 'createdAt', nb.updated_at as 'updatedAt' from notice_board nb join user u on nb.author_id = u.id join profile pf on pf.id = u.profile_id limit #{pageSize} where is_removed = false offset #{offset};

select nb.id as 'id', nb.title as 'title', pf.nickname as 'authorName', nb.content as 'content', nb.view_cnt as 'viewCnt', nb.created_at as 'createdAt', nb.updated_at as 'updatedAt' from notice_board nb join user u on nb.author_id = u.id join profile pf on pf.id = u.profile_id where nb.id = #{id}
select id, saved_file_name as name, path, size from notice_board_image_property where board_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into notice_board (author_id, title, content, view_cnt, is_removed, created_at, updated_at) values (#{authorId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{viewCnt}, #{isRemoved}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt});
mapper.update: update notice_board set is_removed = false, updated_at = NOW() where id = #{id};

update notice_board
title = #{title},
content = #{content},
updated_at = NOW()
where id = #{id};
